\newcommand{\valPrioritySentence}{The ten highest priority scores were recorded in Errachidia, Zagora, Oued Ed-Dahab, Taroudant, Agadir Ida-Outanane, Tata, Marrakech, El Kelaa des Sraghna, Safi and Chichaoua, which lie mainly in the Marrakech--Safi, Souss--Massa and Drâa--Tafilalet regions; five of these ten units are also Gi* hot spots.
